title: Death coordinates
description: Tells you coordinates of your last death
body:
**Death Coordinates** is a simple yet essential utility mod for any Minecraft player. We’ve all been there: you die in an unexpected place, and by the time you run back, you have no idea where your items dropped.
With Death Coordinates, the moment you respawn, the mod automatically sends your exact death coordinates (X, Y, Z) directly into your chat. It’s the perfect way to ensure you never lose your items again.

**Features:**

**Instant Feedback:** Coordinates appear in your chat log immediately after respawning.

**Private:** Coordinates are sent only to your chat—other players on the server won't see where you died.

**Minimalist:** No complex menus, GUIs, or configuration files required. It works perfectly "out of the box."

**Lightweight:** Zero impact on performance; it’s perfect for both single-player survival and multiplayer servers.

**Vanilla-Friendly:** Keeps the core gameplay intact while providing a much-needed quality-of-life improvement.

**Why use this mod?**
Death in Minecraft is often sudden and frustrating. Death Coordinates saves you the stress and wasted time of searching for your items, allowing you to get back into the action as quickly as possible.
